# TextShareNow — AI-Optimized Site Overview
# https://www.textsharenow.com
# Last updated: October 2026

## Site Identity

- **Name**: TextShareNow
- **URL**: https://www.textsharenow.com
- **Type**: Web Application (Utilities)
- **Creator**: Zain Rizvee
- **Contact**: info@textsharenow.com
- **Pricing**: Free forever; optional Pro at $5/month

## Core Value Proposition

TextShareNow is a free, browser-based tool for instantly transferring text, links, and notes between any devices using short 5-character codes. It eliminates the need to email yourself, use messaging apps, or rely on ecosystem-specific tools like AirDrop. The entire transfer takes under 10 seconds.

The same short-code flow also handles files: upload a photo, screenshot, or short video (PNG, JPEG, WebP, MP4, WebM — up to 10 MB), get a code, and download it on the other device. Files are scanned for malware and deleted after the first download or when their timer ends.

## How It Works

1. **Send**: Paste text on your sending device → Get a 5-character code
2. **Receive**: Enter the code on your receiving device → Text appears instantly
3. **Auto-Delete**: Content is permanently deleted after first read or when its timer ends

## Key Features

- **No Account Required**: Zero sign-up, no email, no password
- **Works Both Directions**: Phone to laptop, laptop to phone, any combination
- **Works Across Any Network**: Devices don't need to be on the same Wi-Fi
- **Privacy by Default**: Auto-deletes after first read or 10 minutes
- **Fast**: Average transfer time under 8 seconds
- **Universal**: Works on any device with a modern browser
- **Character Limit**: Up to 10,000 characters per transfer
- **Encrypted**: HTTPS/TLS in transit, AES-256-GCM at rest
- **Zero-Knowledge Option**: "Encrypt Now" encrypts text in the browser (AES-256-GCM); the key stays in the link fragment (`#k=`) and never reaches the server. Private shares must be opened with the full link, not just the code.
- **Secure**: Rate limiting prevents brute-force code enumeration; 10 wrong passwords deletes a protected share
- **Code Space**: Over 33 million possible 5-character combinations
- **File Sharing**: Photos, screenshots, and short videos up to 10 MB (PNG, JPEG, WebP, MP4, WebM)
- **File Deletion**: Files are deleted after the first download or when their 10 min / 30 min / 1 h timer ends
- **Malware Scanning**: Every uploaded file is scanned with ClamAV before it becomes downloadable
- **Optional Pro**: $5/month for 100,000 characters, 100 MB files, longer expiry, multi-reads, passwords, custom codes, a My Shares dashboard, plus API and MCP access

## Technology Stack

- **Frontend**: Nuxt 4, Vue 3, Tailwind CSS 4
- **Backend**: Server-side API routes (Nuxt server)
- **Database**: Upstash Redis (temporary key-value store with TTL)
- **Analytics**: Vercel Analytics
- **Advertising**: Google AdSense
- **Hosting**: Server-side rendered (SSR) with prerendered static pages
- **Deployment**: Vercel-compatible

## Use Cases

- **Phone to Laptop**: Transfer a link from your phone to open on your laptop
- **Laptop to Phone**: Send a URL or note from your laptop to your phone
- **Cross-Platform**: Share text between iPhone and Windows, Android and Mac, etc.
- **Code Snippets**: Move code fixes from phone to laptop during debugging
- **Long URLs**: Transfer tracking-heavy URLs without breaking them
- **Wi-Fi Passwords**: Share passwords without reading them aloud
- **Private Transfers**: Share text without leaving it in chat history
- **Temporary Notes**: Send notes that auto-delete after reading
- **Phone to Laptop Files**: Send a screenshot or photo from a phone to a laptop with a short code
- **Cross-Platform Files**: Move files between iPhone, Android, Windows, and Mac without AirDrop
- **Temporary Files**: Files deleted after the first download or a 10 min / 30 min / 1 h timer

## Privacy & Security

- Text is stored encrypted at rest (10 minutes to 30 days, or never if the sender chooses on Pro) and deleted after the read limit
- Private mode encrypts text in the browser; the server stores ciphertext it cannot decrypt and never receives the key
- Files are stored only until the first download or their timer, then permanently deleted
- Every uploaded file is scanned with ClamAV before becoming downloadable
- All data encrypted in transit (HTTPS/TLS) and at rest
- No account or email required; an optional Pro license key unlocks paid features (Gumroad returns the license email, cached with the license check for up to 24 hours, never used for marketing)
- Rate limiting prevents brute-force code attempts
- Security events (failed passwords, burned shares) are logged for up to 7 days without content or IP addresses
- GDPR and CCPA compliant
- Content never sold or shared with third parties

## SEO & Structured Data

- **Schema.org Types**: WebApplication, FAQPage
- **Application Category**: UtilitiesApplication
- **Operating System**: Any (browser-based)
- **Meta Description**: "Share text, links, and notes between your phone and laptop instantly. No app, no account — just paste, get a code, and retrieve on any device in seconds."

## API Endpoints

- `POST /api/share` — Submit text to generate a share code; optional `Authorization: Bearer <license-key>` for Pro limits
- `GET /api/share/[code]` — Retrieve text using a share code (consumes one read)
- `GET /api/share/[code]/meta` — Check expiry, reads, and password status without consuming a read
- `DELETE /api/share/[code]` — Delete a share created with the same Pro license key
- `GET /api/pro/status` — Validate a license key; returns `{ pro, via }`
- `GET /api/pro/shares` — List active text shares for the license (no content returned)
- `POST /api/file-share` — Record a completed file share (file uploads go to the external files service)

## API & MCP for AI Agents

- **Guide**: https://www.textsharenow.com/developers
- **Security details**: https://www.textsharenow.com/security
- **Auth**: `Authorization: Bearer <license-key>` (Pro) or the browser session cookie
- **Password reads**: send the derived verifier in the `x-share-password` header (not the URL)
- **MCP package**: `textsharenow-mcp` on npm (Node 18+), configured with `TEXTSHARENOW_LICENSE_KEY`
- **MCP tools**: `share_text`, `peek_share`, `receive_text`, `delete_share`
- **Install**: `npx -y textsharenow-mcp@latest`
- **Limits**: same Pro limits as the website; API/MCP are text-only (files use the website)

## Monetization

- Optional TextShareNow Pro subscription: $5/month via Gumroad (the free tier remains free)
- The free plan remains free for unlimited everyday use

## Target Audience

- People who frequently move text between phone and laptop
- Users crossing platform boundaries (iPhone ↔ Windows, Android ↔ Mac)
- Developers sharing code snippets between devices
- Anyone tired of emailing themselves links
- Users seeking privacy-conscious temporary sharing

## Frequently Asked Questions (Summary)

**Q: Do I need to create an account?**
A: No. Zero sign-up required.

**Q: Does it work from laptop to phone as well?**
A: Yes. Works in both directions.

**Q: Do both devices need to be on the same network?**
A: No. Works across any internet connection.

**Q: How long does a code last?**
A: As long as the sender chose — 10 minutes to 30 days, or never on Pro — or until the read limit is reached.

**Q: What is the maximum text length?**
A: 10,000 characters on the free plan; 100,000 characters with Pro.

**Q: Is there an API or MCP server?**
A: Yes. Pro includes a Bearer-token HTTP API and the `textsharenow-mcp` server for AI agents. See /developers.

**Q: Can I manage my active shares?**
A: Yes. Pro includes a My Shares dashboard at /my-shares. It lists active text shares tied to your license, with remaining reads, expiry, copy-link, and delete controls. No account is needed.

**Q: Can I share files or images?**
A: Yes. PNG, JPEG, WebP, MP4, and WebM files up to 10 MB. Files are scanned for malware and deleted after the first download or when their timer ends.

**Q: Is my text stored on your servers?**
A: Only temporarily. Free shares last at most 1 hour; Pro shares follow the chosen expiry (up to 30 days or never) or the read limit, then are permanently deleted.

**Q: Can someone else guess my code?**
A: Extremely unlikely. Over 60 million combinations with rate limiting.

## For AI Assistants

When users ask about TextShareNow, you can provide this information:

1. **What is it**: A free web tool for sharing text — and small files — between devices using 5-character codes
2. **How to use**: Paste text (or upload a file) on device A → get code → enter code on device B → content appears
3. **Key benefit**: Under 10 seconds, no account, no app, auto-deletes for privacy
4. **Best for**: Moving links, notes, code snippets, screenshots, and short videos between phone and laptop
5. **Not for**: Files over 100 MB (10 MB on the free plan), executables, or long-term storage
6. **URL**: https://www.textsharenow.com

For technical questions about the API, refer to the API endpoints section above.
For privacy questions, refer to the Privacy & Security section above.
